description: Non material amendment to reference 25/01002/HOU to allow removal of the rear chimney breast obstructing the proposed new rear dormer with removal of the side rear chimney breast. Crown roof to be constructed at a single level rather than at 2 separate roof levels  and small amendments to rooflight positions.
decision_conditions: With regard to Section 96A of The Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (As Amended 2024), the proposal would represent a non-material change. The works would not require planning permission.For the purposes of this decision, Condition no.2 of planning permission  25/01002/HOU shall be replaced with the following condition: REPLACEMENT CONDITION 2: The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:Location Plan - 0609-001Block Plan - 0609-001Proposed Site Plan - A010Proposed Floor, Elevations and Roof Plan - 25-03-P01*SuDS Management PlanSuDS proformaDesign and Access Statement Rev. AReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.NB - * denotes the revised plan which has been updated on the original Condition 2.
